desc:
The volcano is about to ERUPT! 🌋 Fill your bucket at the village fountain, climb the volcano and pour the water into the crater before it blows.

👥 Team up: 1 to 4 players per room, +15% coins for every friend in your room. Revive your teammates when they fall.
🧗 Climb 8 stages up the volcano: rolling rocks, fire gates, geysers and lava in your way.
🛠️ Spend your team's coins on shortcuts (bridge, zipline, minecart) and on the skill tree.
🪣 Unlock 7 buckets, from the Plastic Bucket to the Obsidian Bucket.
🧑‍🚒 Play 5 classes: Water Carrier, Firefighter, Prospector, Lava Guardian and Volcano Avatar.
🎡 Spin the wheel for diamonds and rare buckets.

Play on phone, PC or console.
